verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly supports combining and orchestrating multiple agents and code execution into workflows, with a graph-based Workflow Runtime supporting routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, nested workflows, and a Task API for structured agent-to-agent delegation (subagents/handoffs), plus multi-agent directory support in its dev UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of multi-agent orchestration in production beyond first-party docs/GitHub.
